What we do

Finding the right therapist shouldn’t be another thing you have to figure out alone

There are different professionals, different approaches and different fees. Knowing where to start can be confusing.

That’s why we begin by getting to know you. Tell us what’s been happening, what you’d like help with, what you’re looking for and what you’re comfortable spending.

Our Care Co-ordinator will help you find a suitable professional from our team. You don’t have to navigate the process alone.

There’s no right or wrong reason to seek support

You might be:

  • Feeling anxious, overwhelmed or emotionally exhausted
  • Struggling with relationships, family or boundaries
  • Finding it difficult to understand yourself or your emotions
  • Questioning your confidence, identity or self-worth
  • Navigating grief, loss or a difficult experience
  • Feeling stuck in your career, your business or your personal life
  • Going through a transition you don’t quite know how to navigate
  • Wanting to break patterns that no longer serve you
  • Simply wanting to understand yourself better

You don’t have to fit into one category. Life rarely works that way.

A note from Janvi

I started Balance Is The New Green with a simple belief: understanding yourself can change the way you experience your entire life.

Mental health is not just about what happens when things go wrong. It’s also about understanding the experiences that shape us, the patterns we carry, the relationships we build and the choices we make.

I wanted to create a space where seeking support felt less intimidating, where people could find the right professional without having to navigate the process alone, and where personal growth and mental healthcare could coexist without compromising the importance of either.

BTNG is built around that belief.

Janvi SikariaFounder, Balance Is The New Green

Janvi is an entrepreneur and a growth and mental wellness practitioner. She is the co-founder of Burger Bae and founder of Bae Rituals, so she knows the weight of building something of your own.

  • Bachelor’s (BA) and Master’s (MA) in Psychology
  • 240+ hours of psychotherapy training
  • Certified in Ikigai Life Coaching, Deep Neural Repatterning (DNR) and Advanced Transformation Life Coaching
  • Entrepreneurship degree from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad
  • PG in Brand Management from FAD International, Mumbai

How it works

  1. Start with a conversation

    Our Care Co-ordinator will get to know what brings you here, what you’re hoping to work on, your preferences and your budget.

  2. Find the right professional

    We help you identify a suitable therapist based on your needs, their qualifications, experience and areas of expertise.

  3. Begin understanding yourself

    Your therapist works with you to explore your experiences, emotions, patterns and the things you’d like to change.

  4. Work towards meaningful change

    Through personalised professional support, you work on the areas affecting your life, at a pace and in a way that’s appropriate for you.

  5. Reflect on how far you’ve come

    You and your therapist periodically review your progress, recognise what’s changing and identify what needs attention next.
